summary: The session discusses the evolution of Tokio Marine's data strategy, focusing on the integration of AI into their operations and the development of sustainable data products. The speaker emphasizes the importance of trust in data governance and the need for a robust data management platform to support AI initiatives. Key highlights include the introduction of automated data product creation and the significance of a semantic layer for contextual understanding.

key_points: Tokio Marine's growth and diversity in insurance lines.
The role of the Chief Data Officer in evolving data strategy.
The importance of understanding data for AI readiness.
Different types of AI: personal, operational, and differential.
Focus on building sustainable data products.
Introduction of a data product factory using generative AI.
Building trust in data through governance and quality measures.
The role of Snowflake in data management.
The importance of a semantic layer for AI models.
Trust by design in data management.
The analogy of an airport control plane for data governance.

key_takeaways: Focus on building a robust data management platform to support AI initiatives.
Implement automated processes for creating sustainable data products.
Establish a semantic layer to enhance contextual understanding of data.
